Lena (People Ops): @here Quick heads-up: micro-townhall this Fri 10:00 AM PT. Short format today — agenda & Q collection below. Please add urgent questions to the form: https://forms.gle/RedwoodTownhallQnA
Priya Desai (Product): Ill cover Dedicated pilot timeline + perf numbers. Will upload draft deck Thu EOD.
Marco Chen (Eng): Ill do a concise 5-min incident recap (autoscaler flapping) and the mitigation steps we applied.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Ill share a brief company health update and emphasize hiring priorities. Planning to keep remarks under 7 mins.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): Request: include two short customer vignettes (one startup, one mid-market) to highlight Dedicated use cases.
Samira R. (Support): Ill drop the top 3 support themes by Wed: billing clarifications, small-model latency, and unexpected 429s.
Lena (People Ops): Format: 30 min total. 12 min exec/product, 8 min eng, 8 min customer/support, 10 min live Q&A. Recording + transcript posted to #all-hands after.
Priya Desai (Product): Question: can we add a single slide summarizing burst vs reserved billing for Dedicated? Customers keep asking.
Marco Chen (Eng): @Priya yes, and Ill mention the rollback policy we pushed last week that helps with gradual rollouts.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): Coordinating with the customer presenter now  will confirm availability by Thu noon.
Lena (People Ops): Please post 1-2 priority Qs in this thread by Wed 12:00 so we can triage the Q&A.
allhands-bot: :bell: Reminder scheduled  Townhall Fri 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent.
Lena (People Ops): Ops note: captions available. DM me if you need live ASR captions turned on.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Heads-up to leads: bring one measurable takeaway for your team to share.
Priya Desai (Product): Deck (v1) uploaded: https://redwood.share/drive/townhall-priya-2026. Will update metrics Thu.
Marco Chen (Eng): Incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/eng/incidents/2026-03-autoscaler. TL;DR mis-sized jobs -> throttling loop; fixed thresholds, added extra metrics.
Samira R. (Support): Support themes posted: billing confusion, edge-case rate limiting, small-model latency spikes. Examples attached in the doc.
Lena (People Ops): FINAL REMINDER: submit top Qs by Wed 12:00. Want to demo? Tell me by Thu morning so we can fit it in.
Lena (People Ops): (after meeting) Recording posted: https://redwood.co/recordings/3950001234-micro-townhall. Key takeaways below.
Lena (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated pilot kickoff next month (select customers). 2) SLA pilot goal 99.95% for critical routes. 3) Autoscaler thresholds patched; observability improved. 4) Billing FAQ to be published next week.
Davina Brooks (Customer Success): Customer demo went well; they liked the burst option and asked about on-prem sizing.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Great run. Follow-up in ~6 weeks for progress check.
Lena (People Ops): Actions & owners posted in the follow-up doc  will share the list in #all-hands. :white_check_mark:
